entries.title: PostReady: PR #809 — Speed up text renders + raise save masters timeout
entries.description: Performance improvements to text rendering speed and raised timeout ceiling for the save masters flow, improving reliability of long-running generation saves.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #808 — Admin Seedream 5.0 smoke-test endpoint
entries.description: Added an admin-only smoke-test endpoint for Seedream 5.0 integration — allows internal verification of the upgraded image engine before exposing to customers.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #807 — Landing: $49 → $39.97 price + CTA reword for one-plan pricing
entries.description: Updated landing page pricing copy from $49 to $39.97 and reworded the CTA to match the consolidated single-plan pricing ($39.97/mo, everything included). Completes the H2+H5 pricing consolidation changes on the public-facing site.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #806 — Remove dead customer-facing AI video feature (#669)
entries.description: Removed dormant customer-facing AI video surfaces that were left behind the VIDEO_ENABLED=off flag after the small-business pivot. Video generation is no longer part of the product.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #805 — Remove redundant page-level Schedule heading
entries.description: Removed redundant Schedule page heading that duplicated the sidebar nav label, aligning with the redesigned Schedule page (PR #804) and the unified Create-area design system.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #804 — Redesign schedule page to approved mockup
entries.description: Schedule page rebuilt to match the approved mockup, aligned with the unified Create area design system shipped across tabs in Jul–Aug.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #803 — Remove add-on purchase flows (clip packs + image top-ups)
entries.description: Stripped all add-on purchase UI — clip packs and image top-up flows removed. Follows the single-plan pricing consolidation (PR #801): one $39.97/mo plan, no à-la-carte purchases.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #802 — Redesign Batch Create page to match approved mockup
entries.description: Batch Create page redesigned to match the approved owner mockup — aligned with the Create tab's design system.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #801 — One customer plan: $39.97/mo, unlimited images (fair-use) (H2 #702)
entries.description: Collapsed billing to one customer-facing plan: $39.97/mo with a fair-use ceiling of 150 AI images/month. Everything customer-facing reads "unlimited". No tiers, no add-ons.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #800 — Pricing page: one plan ($39.97/mo, everything included) (H5 #705)
entries.description: Rebuilt the pricing page around a single plan: $39.97/month, everything included, 7-day free trial. Replaces the 3-column Starter/Pro/Business tier comparison.
